summary: The root وَكَلَ (wakala) primarily means to rely upon someone, confide in them, or submit oneself to them.
lane: 5 تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ ذ , and عليه , He relied upon him; (S, Msb;) and confided in him: (Msb:) he submitted himself to him. (K.) -b2- تَوَكَّلَ بِالأَمْرِ He became responsible to him for the management of the affair. (TA.) -b3- تَوَكَّلَ لَهُ بِهِ He became responsible to him for it. (TA.) -b4- تَوَكَّلَ فِى أَمْرٍ He became وَكِيل in an affair. -b5- توكّل بِمَالِ أَحَدٍ He became administrator of one's property.

headwords.gloss: He left him to his opinion; judgment; I left him to himself

parts.t: He left him to his opinion,
I did not manage his affair, nor aid him.
Leave thou me to manage such a thing.
I left him to his religion, not interfering with him therein

headwords.def: وَكَلَهُ إِلَى رَأْيِهِ , inf. n. وَكْلٌ and وُكُولٌ , He left him to his opinion, or judgment. (TA.) And وَكَلْتُهُ إِلَى نَفْسِهِ , aor. يَكِلُ , inf. n. وُكُولٌ , [ I left him to himself; ] I did not manage his affair, nor aid him. (Msb.) And كِلْنِى إِلَى كَذَا Leave thou me to manage such a thing. (TA.) وَكَلْتُهُ إِلَى دِينِهِ [ I left him to his religion, not interfering with him therein ]. (S, Msb, K, voce دَيَّنْتُهُ .)

headwords.gloss: He appointed him; intrusted him, as his commissioned agent, factor, or deputy, with the management, or disposal, of a thing; I associated a

parts.t: intrusted him, as his commissioned agent, factor, or deputy, with the management, or disposal, of a thing.

headwords.def: وَكَّلَهُ بِشَىْءٍ He appointed him, or intrusted him, as his commissioned agent, factor, or deputy, with the management, or disposal, of a thing. وَكَّلْتُ بِفُلَانٍ I associated a وَكِيل [or factor, &c.] with such a one. (T in art. بِ .)

headwords.gloss: He relied upon him; and confided in him; he submitted himself to him

parts.t: He became responsible to him for the management of the affair.
He became responsible to him for it.
He became administrator of one's property.

headwords.def: تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْهِ , and عليه , He relied upon him; (S, Msb;) and confided in him: (Msb:) he submitted himself to him. (K.) تَوَكَّلَ بِالأَمْرِ He became responsible to him for the management of the affair. (TA.) تَوَكَّلَ لَهُ بِهِ He became responsible to him for it. (TA.) تَوَكَّلَ فِى أَمْرٍ He became وَكِيل in an affair. توكّل بِمَالِ أَحَدٍ He became administrator of one's property.

headwords.gloss: He deserted him; it: i. q
headwords.def: تَوَاكَلَهُ He deserted him, or it: i. q. تركته : see two exs. voce سَدِرٌ .

parts.t: is used as an inf. n. of

headwords.def: إِوْتَكَلَ see 5. مُتَّكَلٌ is used as an inf. n. of اِتَّكَلَ .

headwords.gloss: impotent man; who commits his affair to another

parts.t: who commits his affair to another.

headwords.def: وَكَلٌ and and An impotent man, (S, K,) who commits his affair to another. (S.)

headwords.gloss: A witness; A commissioned agent; a factor; a deputy

parts.t: A commissioned agent; a factor; a deputy.

headwords.def: وَكِيلٌ A witness; syn. شَهِيدٌ . (Jel, ii. 66; and iv. 169.) A commissioned agent; a factor; a deputy.
وَكَالَةٌ , for دَارُ الوَكَالَةِ , A factory: pl. وَكَائِلُ .

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
